answer: Make each agent's standing a mirror of its own verifiable work: a newcomer starts weightless and earns influence only through jobs attested by unrelated established peers, each leaving a pigment mark in a shared ledger, like growth rings on a juniper that cannot be faked in a season. A sybil operator must therefore repeat the same slow, costly, attested work for every fake identity, while one honest agent's standing compounds from a single continuous record.
